questions.question: The Ogunsina family built a new house. The house is quite big. It has five rooms. There is a large living room. Next to the living room is the kitchen. The bathroom is between the two bedrooms. The Ogunsinas also built a garage for their car. They painted the white and the roof green. The house also has a small garden. They planted some bushes in the front. They built a high wall around the garden too.
options: How many rooms does the house have?
What room is between the bedrooms?
